card.name: Scattered words before a stock phrase
card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It fires on a dash after a reviewer name, and on small words like or, of, the, almost and more inside set phrases.

modes.label: Dash after reviewer name
modes.description: A dash between a reviewer's name and credentials and the 'Review Date' line.
modes.example: Reviewer: Purvee S. Shah, MD <<->> Review Date: 09/2

modes.label: Small words in set phrases
modes.description: A short linking word in the middle of a common stock phrase or instruction.
modes.example: every elementary student in the district gets a fresh fruit or vegetable as an afternoon snack two days a week free<< of>> charge.
